notes.title: 🌾Grass Cutting Incremental is coming to Steam & REVO Massive Minerals Update!!
notes.notes:
[b]We’ve got some massive announcements to share![/b]


[b]🌾Grass Cutting Incremental is coming to Steam, Android, and iOS in partnership with LethalDolphin![/b]

Yes you read that right! We’re beyond excited to officially announce that Oni Gaming will be publishing and porting the legendary Roblox incremental game Grass Cutting Incremental, originally created by LethalDolphin.

This isn’t just a quick port — it's a full rebuild for PC and mobile, with:
[list]
[*] A brand-new UI and design tailored for Steam and mobile platforms.
[*] Touch controls and performance optimization.
[*] New features and systems to elevate the gameplay experience.
[/list]The original creator, LethalDolphin, is actively involved and will supervise the project to ensure the new version stays true to the original spirit while pushing the experience further.

[b]Don’t expect a release before 2026[/b], but we’ll be sharing progress and previews along the way.
We’re hiring for this game, recruitment info at the end.


[b]🟡 REVO - Massive Minerals Update Incoming![/b]

The next REVO update is currently in testing and [b]aims for a release around June 20[/b]. That’s an approximate date, so stay tuned in #revo-spoiler for previews!

This update is huge, focusing entirely on [b]Minerals[/b], and brings:
[list]
[*] [b]Crafting[/b] mechanics using minerals.
[*] [b]Polish Prestige[/b] allowing you to buy and upgrade 5 unique weapons with specifics power.
[*] [b]Refine Tree[/b] with 80-100 upgrade nodes.
[*] 10 types of [b]Special Minerals[/b], each upgradable.
[*] [b]Runes Upgrades[/b] Sun and Moon.
[/list]

[b]To Our Amazing Community[/b] ❤️

With over 90,000 demons in our Discord, we’re constantly humbled by your passion and support. While many of you are eagerly waiting for new games and features, we want to reaffirm this:
[list]
[*] [b]We will always prioritize quality over quantity.[/b]
[*] Every update, system, and game is built with love, care, and polish to make sure your experience is the best it can be (well, most of the time 😈).
[/list]Thank you for being a part of this journey. [b]More is coming. Stay tuned![/b]

The Oni Gaming Team

notes.title: Revolution Idle is officially launching in Version 1.0!
notes.notes:
After nearly 8 months in Early Access, we’re excited to announce that [b]Revolution Idle is now releasing![/b]
With a solid foundation and a wealth of content already in place, we feel it's the perfect time to make the leap to [b]version 1.0.[/b]

Development is still in full swing, and we have [b]plenty of new features and updates[/b] planned for the near future.
Stay tuned, the revolution has only just begun!

Thanks to your incredible support, the game has far exceeded our expectations and we’re more motivated than ever to keep pushing it further.

notes.title: Get Ready for z'Unity Update!
notes.notes:

After months of development, the Unity update is finally here and it’s... a game-changer! Unity marks the third prestige level and pushes the boundaries of what you thought possible in Revolution Idle.

[b][i]A New Cosmic Frontier[/i][/b]
Reach an astronomical *1.08 × 10^2466 EP* a number so vast it outnumbers the atoms in the observable universe.

[b]Astrology[/b]
Collect rare Zodiacs and pair them with the 12 planets to unlock unique bonuses. Find the perfect combination to boost your power even further.

[b][i]Challenge Yourself with Trials and Relics[/i][/b]

Once you’re equipped for ascension, dive into 18 challenging missions with escalating difficulty. Complete each trial to get bonuses, reset Unity and try again if needed.

[b]Relics[/b]
Embark on a sub-revolution quest to earn gold and unlock 20 relics. Each relic carries a unique power, speeding up your progress and delivering massive damage boosts. Indiana Jones has nothing on you!

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/35573548768729383/50223508FB5A8E905CB466AA59BEBA9EA98EE43A/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[b][i]Advanced Automations[/i][/b]
We're making it easier for you to progress with powerful new automations:
- Autobuy Animal Points (AP)
- Autobuy Animals
- Autobuy Laboratory Upgrades
- Research Point (RP) Distribution
- Auto Supernova
- Automate Dilation Tree Points (DTP)
- Autobuy Dilation Upgrades

Take full control of the game with our new Macro feature! Use logic blocks to create custom automations and discover the perfect formula for rapid progression.

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/35573548768730928/AB36A7278D39ED96157F0DE9755F43952E599CDB/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

[b][i]Mark Your Calendar[/i][/b]
Join us on *April 18* to experience all these revolutionaries features firsthand. We’re excited to hear your feedback and continue evolving Revolution Idle together.

Prepare for revolution. The cosmos awaits! 

Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/onigaming]Discord[/url]

We spent the night working to changes a few things and fixes some issues

The start pack doesnt have a timer anymore, you can buy it after a week if you want.

The purchase also work for everyone, it was a language problem in the code that was trying to force to US, which isnt really a supported language 😜

The version is already live on steam as this is where the problem was, and will soon come to android/ios, so even if you still see the timer on the pack, the update will be live before it expire 😁

Thank you for the incredible support and your understanding
I am only the publisher for this game and @denisolenison is the main creator which does all the content and balancing, with @waraw who handle all the backend, polishing, improving and bug fixing. 
This is their first game going live on multiple platforms, they did a great job despite the few issue that happened. 

We will continue to fixes bugs for the next few days, then Denis will start the next content 😁

notes.title: Delay In The Release Of The Game
notes.notes:
Sadly... we just got news that the build wasn't approved, there is a few minor errorsr, We are going to work hard to fix and submit the game again. It is usually faster to get after the initial process. I wont give a new date right now, but instead i will keep you update on the progress in the forum.

I know this can be pretty disappointing... I heard steam has had a few issues earlier this week, which could be why reviewing is taking longer. 

Thank you for understanding, be assured that as soon as the game is ready to go live, I will let you all know and give a new date for the release.

notes.title: Revolution Idle release on October 3rd! Steam & Android link!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone !

First, we want to apologize for length of time since our initial announcement several months ago regarding Revolution Idle's updated release. Unfortunately, real life got in the way of development. However, things are now back on track!

So mark your calendars! After months of hard work and fine tuning, we are excited to announce that Revolution Idle will be launching on October 3rd! We have spent these extra few months polishing the game and adding even more features to make this an experience you won't want to miss! Whether you are an old incremental gaming veteran who remembers playing it seven years ago or a newer idle addict, there should be something for everyone!

Developed by Nu Games and Oni Gaming, Revolution Idle will be available on Steam, Android, and iOS. Whether you're aiming for the familiar infinity, shooting for the stars, or heading for the newer eternity, we hope you will join us on our mesmerizing adventure!

And until the game's release in October, please don’t forget to wishlist Revolution Idle on Steam and Android! That will help spread the word!

Thanks for your patience and support! We’re looking forward to seeing you in-game!
